name: PacBio HiFi RNA-seq Transcript Quantification Benchmark
description: Systematically measures how high-accuracy PacBio long-read RNA sequencing performs for transcript-level quantification, comparing methods on sensitivity, precision, and isoform resolution.
evaluation_method: precision / recall / F1 (sensitivity and precision for transcript detection)
reputation: A specialized benchmark valued in the long-read transcriptomics community for assessing isoform-level quantification with HiFi data.
notes: Non-LLM bioinformatics benchmark; results can be platform- and protocol-specific, limited by dataset size and sample diversity, and sensitive to contamination and reference annotation quality.
